_help: Config for the three Telegram bots. Each bot's token lives only in GitHub Secrets and is never committed here. Edit this file to change where/when/what each bot posts. See admin-help.html for the full walkthrough.

shared._calendarPhotosFolderUrlNote: Public Drive folder admins upload event photos to. Set this once, then paste the link into admin-help for a direct jump. Sharing MUST be set to 'Anyone with the link: Viewer' on the folder itself.

announcements.footer: — Posted automatically from our calendar. See the News page for full details.

bible._messageThreadIdNote: Leave null to post into the General topic. For a specific topic, use the middle number from https://t.me/<chat>/<threadId>/<messageId>.

saturday.bodyIntro: Join us in the Word, brought to you by Seed the Word Ministry.
saturday.bodyReview: We'll be reviewing what we have been reading throughout the week, catching up on missed discussions, diving deeper into God's Word.
saturday.bodyGoal: The goal is to promote critical thinking amongst the body of Jesus Christ, who are capable of discerning what is Scripture based and that of what is from the enemy.
saturday.bodyRulesNote: Please review the S.E.E.D. Rules for more information on recent changes.

playlist._worshipTopicNote: The Worship & Music topic where weekly digests post. Falls back to the Bible bot's messageThreadId if null.

prayer._note: Disabled May 12 2026 — the Bible bot now includes a Prayer & Thanksgiving block in its daily post to thread 1, so this separate nudge would double up. Re-enable by flipping enabled to true.
